text:
alex_k: FYI I’m seeing a rising 5xx tail on the v2 canary shard after the 11:05 traffic ramp, ~12% error ratio on p95. lowering ramp threshold?
maria_g: Ugh. Can you paste the failing path or error class?
alex_k: Mostly gateway 503s from edge-proxy, stacktrace points to model-mux timeouts, sample logs: `2026-03-21T11:06:03Z ERROR mux.go:218 timeout after 3.0s`
deploy-bot: deploybot: canary rollout initiated by @ryan_p — v2 -> 30% traffic (regions: us-west, eu-central) — id: db-3372
ops_jen: Is this limited to eu or both regions?
alex_k: Both, but eu is worse (14% vs 9%). suspect regional capacity + kv cache warmup.
samir_r: Telemetry: increased latency on key route `/v2/generate` correlates with cache miss rate bump. Sending charts.
maria_g: Ok let's enact an escape window: pause further ramps and shift eu back to 10% while we investigate. Who can add pin for affected tenants if needed?
ryan_p: I’ll pause the main pipeline. /deploybot pause-rollout db-3372
deploy-bot: deploybot: rollout db-3372 paused at 30% (operator: ryan_p)
ops_jen: I recommend pinning mobile-sdk clients for the next 30m for safety: tenant ids T-42, T-88. Add to pinlist?
alex_k: +1 for pinning T-42 only for now, T-88 seems low traffic. Maria can advise for product.
maria_g: Pin T-42 and create a soft rollback rule: if p95 errors > 10% for 5m auto-shift eu -> 0%. I’ll update release notes.
samir_r: Created a quick alarm: `if (p95_errors('/v2/generate', region='eu') > 10) for 5m then notify ops and trigger traffic-shift('eu',0)`
ryan_p: Can we do a manual graceful fallback first? Set route fallback to v1 for tenant T-42 only. Command: `curl -XPOST https://ops.redwood/route/pin -d '{"tenant":"T-42","to":"v1"}'`
ops_jen: I ran the pin command and verified: `pinlist: T-42 -> v1 (effective now)`
deploy-bot: deploybot: traffic-shift applied: eu v2 -> 10% (immediate) by ops_jen
alex_k: After the shift eu p95 dropped to 2.4s and 5xx went down to 4% within 90s. Starting post-shift probe.
maria_g: Good. Make sure release notes capture the pin and the temporary mitigation so CS can message tenants. Link: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-21-v2-ramp
samir_r: Will run deeper root cause tracing on mux and kv cache eviction patterns, cc @eng-runtime.
ryan_p: Decision tree: leave canary paused, investigate 2h, if no regression we can resume slow ramp to 20% and run another 30m stability window. Otherwise rollback to v1 globally for affected routes.
ops_jen: Noted. I’ll keep the rollback playbook ready and set operator eyes.
maria_g: I updated the rollout doc and pinned the change window to 11:00-13:00 UTC with ops eyes. Also added a note for the staging-to-prod cache warmup step to be added to future deploys.
alex_k: Thanks — monitoring now. Will post follow-ups in this thread. :eyes:
ryan_p: marking this thread for postmortem if root cause requires codefix.
deploy-bot: deploybot: reminder: paused rollout db-3372 — run `/deploybot resume db-3372` to continue when ready.
